name: agentic-aac-board-maker
description: Generate evidence-informed, accessible AAC boards, classroom communication resources, eye-gaze tools, and ICP assessment supports from teacher intent.

interface.shortDescription: Generate accessible AAC and ICP classroom resources
interface.longDescription: Turns teacher intent into draft AAC boards, visual supports, printable resources, Open AAC Studio JSON, offline HTML tools, and ICP evidence packages with communication rights, access method, curriculum/QCIA translation, privacy, and QA built in.
defaultPrompt: Make an eye-gaze AAC board for this lesson.
Create a QCIA community access board.
Draft an ICP backwards map and rubric.
